units.translation: ⟦1⟧ exactly like ⟦2⟧ ⟦3⟧, to the nearest. ⟦4⟧ 101 is very striking, first because of the middle voice, which is found nowhere, and then because of the ī, with which only ⟦5⟧ ⟦6⟧ can be compared, while otherwise ⟦7⟧ is short (also probably ⟦8⟧, at any rate Rhes. 494). I therefore write ⟦9⟧, since in the future the middle is far more common; at the same time the connection with 103 becomes better, in that the angry question contains a demand (as at 124).

The address to the chorus in the singular is so common that no offense should be taken; similar change at 118 ⟦1⟧. 124 ⟦2⟧, and then further in the singular; 180 ⟦3⟧, 181 ⟦4⟧, etc. The heart is ⟦5⟧ also ⟦6⟧, and the ⟦7⟧ (in the literal sense) adjacent. Hermann's change ⟦8⟧ (where they come from) is completely wrong; it also conflicts with 592. The summons ⟦9⟧. is then justified by ⟦10⟧., as Pindar Frg. 131 of the immortal part of man: ⟦11⟧· ⟦12⟧, and the whole chapter ⟦13⟧, especially also (Stanley) Aelian V. h. 3, 11 according to "Peripatetics": — — ⟦14⟧ (⟦15⟧) ⟦16⟧ (i.e. ⟦17⟧) ⟦18⟧, ⟦19⟧. To ⟦20⟧ Blaydes compares ⟦21⟧ ⟦22⟧, from Sophocles' Phineus according to the schol.; see also ⟦23⟧ ⟦24⟧. But what is the point of the contrast at 105, which has no application to this situation, in which it is day? Moreover, ⟦25⟧ is unsuitable for this, and if one writes ⟦26⟧ according to the scholion: ⟦27⟧, the repetition is disturbing, and it is always idle philosophizing.
but it sleeps while the limbs are active
but to those sleeping in many dreams it shows the judgment of pleasant and grievous things creeping upon them
and at night, having been dissolved
and having been made spherical in the region around the chest, it becomes more prophetic
it has been given eyes and the pupils have been brightened
the portion of the mind does not foresee in the day

With ⟦1⟧ one can compare 476 ⟦2⟧, i.e. their nature and kind given by fate; but with ⟦3⟧, it seems to me, one should think of Clytemnestra's own experience, since she foresaw nothing and let herself be caught, despite having thought so much about this case in advance and having tried to win over the Erinyes, 106 ff. And her spirit too had been clairvoyant in a dream, ⟦4⟧ 523 ff.
